# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette Pullen is a young woman who attends community and school functions in Brierley and surrounding areas. She pays attention to fine clothing, jewelry, and physical features like hair color during public events.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v1 c33 P45](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0045)_

## Personality

Odette possesses a pragmatic, straightforward, and relaxed demeanor toward her work and responsibilities. Unlike her peer Nell Harcourt, she does not seek to be a lofty moral inspiration to her students, focusing instead on earning her pay, satisfying the school board, and earning a place on the Inspector's honor roll. She views physical punishment as a simple, direct method for maintaining order and discipline in the classroom. She appreciates material comforts, such as fine jewels and financial independence, and she speaks candidly about her career goals.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v1 c33 P45](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0045), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Goals

- Earn her salary, satisfy the school board, and reach the Inspector's honor roll  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>
- Maintain a lifelong teaching career to earn an independent income without marrying  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette studied in Brierley and joined the Regent's class alongside classmates Nell Harcourt, Hugh Carrow, Opal Pettigrew, Flossie Tulk, Wilfred Mott, and Elias Purdy MacKinnon to prepare for the Entrance examination and qualify as a teacher. She expressed a firm intent to dedicate her life to teaching rather than marriage to secure her own financial independence. Following her training, she accepted a teaching post in Stonebridge. On the evening of August 31, prior to the start of the school term, she met Nell and Hugh at the junction of the Aspen Path and the main road. During their conversation, Odette debated methods of classroom discipline with Nell and Hugh, openly advocating for physical punishment to maintain order. She also attended B.V.I.S. meetings in Brierley, where she expressed suspicion regarding Judson Tibbs's sudden agreement to support the society's goals.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P10](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0010), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v2 c14 P59](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0059)_
